$comment: Working template for golden v1.0 (50 tickets). Exemplars TICKET-0001..0005 are final; fill TICKET-0006..0050 per guidelines.md, then run validate.py --file ... --expect 50 --strict before freezing. Do not edit exemplar labels.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.account: login, password, profile, subscription status, data requests

refund.instructions: Does the customer ask for money back?

records.text: Hi, I was billed twice for my annual CloudSync Pro renewal — [ORDER] shows two charges of $249, one on the 3rd and one on the 4th. I already checked with my bank. Please refund the duplicate charge today.

meta.notes: Money-primary complaint → billing; explicit time pressure ('today') + money blocked → 1; direct money-back ask → refund true.

records.text: The desktop app crashes every time I try to export a board larger than 50 cards. There's a workaround (exporting in chunks) so it's not blocking me, but it should be fixed at some point.

meta.notes: Something broken → technical; explicit workaround + no time claim → 0 despite the crash (impact-based, not tone-based).

records.text: We're evaluating CloudSync Pro for a team of 12. Is there a discount at that seat count, and does the Business plan include the audit log add-on or is that priced separately?

meta.notes: Pre-purchase pricing question → sales; pure question → 0.

records.text: My account got locked this morning after the 2FA reset and I cannot access CloudSync Pro at all — I have client deliverables due tomorrow and the paid product is completely unusable. Nothing I try unlocks it.

meta.notes: H2 variant: account-access blocking is the primary state (not the invoice context) → account; 'cannot access paid product at all' asserted → 2.

records.text: Your November invoice double-charged the seat count after we removed two users. No need to send anything back to my card — please just issue a credit note for the difference and apply it to the next invoice.

meta.notes: H4: money-adjacent wording, but a credit note is store credit, NOT money back → refund false. Money complaint → billing; no time claim → 0.
